summary: Market mood is broadly risk-off: hawkish Federal Reserve expectations, elevated geopolitical risk, and higher yields are pressuring crypto and precious metals, while Nvidia’s stronger outlook is supporting technology equities.[1][3][4] Bitcoin and Ether remain range-bound to weak ahead of the FOMC minutes, whereas oil prices are volatile as Middle East supply risks offset inventory-driven downside.[3][7]
